boundary: Level 4 would be clearly right if the recording were established as covert (e.g. clients had declined or been kept unaware) or the content were highly sensitive; level 3 is clearly right if participant consent to audio capture were documented.
factor: recording external parties without established consent
note: fact_layer is 'misread' (the assessor called the recording 'covert' and said clients expected no audio, both unsupported), but those misreadings push toward a higher level, not the predicted 3, so they do not explain the error. favoured_level 3 equals the prediction, so the disagreement is where the 3/4 line lies; gold 4 weights the unconsented recording of third parties more heavily. Labelled threshold despite fact_layer not being 'correct'.
